definitions.explanation: A person making the pilgrimage to the 88 temples associated with the Buddhist monk Kūkai (Kōbō Daishi) on the island of Shikoku.
The act of visiting the 88 temples of Shikoku, either on foot, by bus, or by car. The full walking route is approximately 1,200 km.

notes:
The お is honorific; the base form is ⟦{遍路|へんろ}→遍路：31830_henro⟧, and pilgrims are respectfully called お{遍路|へんろ}さん.

CULTURAL NOTE:
- The traditional pilgrim wears a {白衣|びゃくえ} (white robe) and carries a {金剛杖|こんごうづえ} (walking staff).
- Local people offer pilgrims お⟦{接待|せったい}→接待：12903_settai⟧: food, drink or a place to rest.
- The circuit can be walked in one go (⟦{通|とお}し→通す：02300_toosu⟧{打|う}ち) or in sections over several trips (⟦{区切|くぎ}り→区切り：21082_kugiri⟧{打|う}ち).
